links.outcome: Intra-model response consistency across repeated submissions of the same question
links.effect: Response consistency varied significantly: ChatGPT-4.0 and DeepSeek-R1 differed from Gemini-2.0 (p=0.034 and p=0.044, respectively).
links.quote: Response consistency varied significantly, with ChatGPT-4.0 and DeepSeek-R1 showing differences from Gemini-2.0 (p=0.034 and p=0.044, respectively).

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers versus ESGO/ESTRO/ESP cervical cancer guidelines (GQS 1-5)
links.effect: GQS 5 rates: ChatGPT-4.0 42%, Gemini-2.0 30%, DeepSeek-R1 28%. Mean GQS 3.02 for DeepSeek-R1 vs 3.74 for ChatGPT-4.0 (p=0.022).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 achieved the highest performance, with 42% of responses rated GQS 5, followed by Gemini-2.0 (30%) and DeepSeek-R1 (28%).

screen.reason: The study is an empirical in silico benchmark evaluating the accuracy, repeatability, and guideline alignment of three LLMs on clinical questions derived from cervical cancer guidelines.
